summary: Phase 12b Telemetry Testing - Privacy-safe product analytics implementation verified. Backend API endpoints tested and working correctly. Frontend telemetry client confirmed to be sending batched events. Admin analytics dashboard endpoints all functional.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/track/batch with 2 events returns {ok:true, accepted:2}
Backend: POST /api/track/batch with 60 events correctly rejects with 422 (Pydantic max_length=50 validation)
Backend: Password scrubbing in meta field - sensitive keys (password, token, email) removed, safe fields preserved
Backend: Admin analytics summary endpoint returns all required sections (scorecard, funnel, entry_sources, device_compare, percorsi, onlyfans, swipe, secret, home)
Backend: Admin analytics models table endpoint returns model list
Backend: Admin analytics timeseries endpoint returns time-series data
Backend: Admin analytics raw events endpoint returns paginated event log
Frontend: Age gate renders on initial page load
Frontend: Telemetry client is active and sending batch requests (5 batches captured during page load)
Frontend: Analytics storage initialized (localStorage ls_visitor_id and sessionStorage ls_visit)

success_percentage.frontend: Partial - Telemetry confirmed working (batches being sent), full UI regression testing limited by age gate timeout in automated testing. Manual verification recommended for complete UI flow testing.

track_batch_validation.details: Correctly rejects with 422 due to Pydantic schema max_length=50 validation

privacy_scrubbing.details: Sensitive keys (password, token, email, authorization, cookie) are removed from meta field. Safe fields are preserved. Verified by direct database query.

admin_analytics_summary.details: Returns all required sections: scorecard (46 visite, 52 profili), funnel, entry_sources, device_compare, percorsi, onlyfans, swipe, secret, home

admin_analytics_timeseries.details: Returns time-series data with 2 data points for 7-day range

admin_analytics_events.details: Returns paginated event log (474 total events, showing 10 per page)

analytics_client_active.details: 5 batch requests captured during initial page load, confirming analytics.js is active and batching events

storage_initialization.details: ls_visitor_id in localStorage and ls_visit in sessionStorage are being created

age_gate_rendering.test: Age gate displays on first visit
age_gate_rendering.details: Age gate modal renders correctly with 'Ho almeno 18 anni' button

testing_limitations.note: Full UI regression testing (model cards, filmstrip, profile navigation, secret mode, CTA visibility, swipe navigation) was limited by page load timeout when waiting for networkidle with age gate present. The telemetry system is confirmed working (batches being sent), but comprehensive UI flow testing would benefit from manual verification or adjusted automation strategy (e.g., pre-setting age gate bypass in localStorage).

for_comprehensive_ui_testing: Set localStorage 'ls_age_ok'='1' before page load to bypass age gate in automated tests
Use 'domcontentloaded' instead of 'networkidle' for initial page load
Test entry_source values by navigating through different paths (home_card, filmstrip, surprise, direct_profile)
Verify visit_id consistency across multiple page navigations within same session
Confirm monotonic seq values in captured batch events
Test batch size limits (< 20KB per batch, < 15 batches for typical user journey)
